scope: Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Chapter 3 (with Online Appendix A1.2-A1.6, A1.9.1): A bit of generality. Long-term debt with finite and geometric maturity structures (flow plus transversality equivalent to the present value), price jumps and forward guidance; ratios to GDP; stochastic discount factors, inverse returns and ex-post present values (which converge on every finite event tree); money and the three present-value forms with their transversality conditions; the log-linear identities as exact derivatives (rho = e^{-(r-g)}, bond-return weight omega/(1+i)), the unexpected-inflation and weighted-inflation identities, Figure 3.1 reconciled; the MSV solution; continuous time with short, long and general maturity densities, linear identities and money; links between discrete and continuous weights and valuations. Printed errors corrected with Lean counterexamples.
source: John H. Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Princeton University Press, Chapter 3, pp. 52-80, and Online Appendix A1.2-A1.6 and A1.9.1.
